commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one bespoke high-quality widescreen PNG website hero, landscape 16:9, painterly cinematic editorial illustration, luminous daylight, fine tactile materials and atmospheric depth. This is a fictional symbolic landscape for a personal essay, not a photograph of the author or his actual family. No lettering, typography, UI, logos, watermarks, or legible writing. Composition: visually quiet pale negative space across the left 45% for a dark headline; richly composed meaningful scene concentrated on the right, main focal objects at 65–85% width; keep scene readable when cropped on mobile. Elegant, hopeful, deeply humane, grounded rather than kitschy.

prompts.christian: Christian perspective: an open stone chapel doorway on the right opening onto a sunlit olive garden and a winding path beyond. A simple wooden table with bread, an earthenware water jug and an empty chair offered toward the viewer. A small, understated wooden cross integrated in the architecture, no people, no depiction of Jesus. Leaves cast delicate shadows; morning light suggests grace, welcome, service and renewed life. Palette warm ivory, sage and olive green, muted honey gold. Left side softly textured ivory plaster fading into light.
prompts.dad: Dad perspective: a beautiful Australian-feeling coast with clear shallow rock pools, sea-glass water, warm sand and rounded limestone. On the right, two small anonymous figures, an adult and child, seen from behind at a respectful distance, looking together into a rock pool; relaxed equal attention, no faces or identifiable likenesses. A simple kite rests nearby, a path returns toward shelter. Theme presence, curiosity, protection and growing room. Bright gentle morning, not sunset. Palette pale aqua, deep coastal teal, warm sand and soft terracotta. Left side an airy cream beach with quiet sky.
prompts.sourcerer: Sourcerer perspective: an airy open observatory workshop, a luminous teal glass computational instrument on a copper and timber workbench on the right. Interlocking transparent mechanical modules, carefully routed fine copper connections, a few arranged test pieces and an open notebook with only abstract unlabelled geometrical marks. Open doors reveal a calm landscape and morning sky. Suggest understandable machinery, accountable engineering and curiosity; no hologram UI, no cyberpunk neon, no stock-photo programmer. No people. Palette cool porcelain, deep teal, sea green and restrained copper. Left side quiet pale wall and diffuse morning light.
prompts.author: Author perspective: a sunlit writer’s library opening onto a fantastical terraced landscape on the right. A handsome wooden desk, open blank manuscript, a fountain pen and a few richly bound unlabelled books; an arched opening frames distant bridges, gardens and small imagined towers woven into a continuous believable world. A delicate curl of paper becomes a path through the landscape, suggesting words becoming worlds without visual clutter. No people. Palette luminous parchment, misty lavender, plum ink and soft brass. Left side a quiet pale lavender plaster wall fading into daylight.
